scope: Static city drawing-language review only. No production game, old review or route-animation changes.
pipeline: Representative warehouse/truck/foliage redraw using original character as separate style reference
Full-map redraw referencing repaired layout, immutable girl and accepted drawing-language sample
Separate natural seated crew under glass; admit only projectively fitted front windshield
Whole generated image registration with projective architectural and vehicle regions; continuous road/fence transitions; narrow generated-texture edge bleed
Original girl composited only from unchanged pre-existing RGB-identical cutout

character.editing: None. Original RGB plus pre-existing alpha. Display resampling only.

motion.exhaust: reused unchanged pass12 smoke.mjs; trucks1/4 only

limitations: The result is a drawing-language candidate, not a user-approved style match.
Drawn ground shadows have more contrast and definition than pass12, although they remain short and the scene remains daylight.
Source geometry remains exact; the generated painting is registered to its placement and checked semantically, not a dimensionally exact CAD rendering.
Continuous registration can introduce small local distortions in surrounding pavement and peripheral cropped art. No old-looking architectural patches are inserted.
Natural crew is visible in a static test pose only.
